paragraph: Of the 314 accepted candidates matching the 314 tickets, 0 have len(team_ids)==0 (distribution={2: 314}). provider.py DOES populate team_ids from (home_id, away_id) when present; evaluate_filters DOES loop for tid in candidate.team_ids, so an empty tuple makes MAX_TEAM_EXPOSURE structurally unreachable. Ids are populated on this set; zero MAX_TEAM_EXPOSURE rejects are therefore not from an empty-tuple structural dead filter alone - weekly exposure likely binds first, or same-team collisions are rare at the observed stake sizes.
